title: The screw joint of userJointTest.py with ObjectJointUser fails beyond 180 degrees of rotation
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG7.15 (maintainer 2026-10-25): the screw joint drafted in userJointTest.py does not work beyond a rotation of 180 degrees; find whether the constraint (the angle by atan2) or the numerical Jacobian causes it, and fix it.
releaseNotes: The screw joint of userJointTest.py works over several turns: its coupling of angle and translation is written periodic, pitch*sin(angle - x/pitch) = 0, with its jacobianUserFunction; an angle computed by atan2 jumps by 2 pi at half a turn, so that the constraint had no continuous solution beyond 180 degrees.
